d: Born with spasticity, Komal’s life began with challenges most could never imagine. Dependent on his parents for daily care, he spent much of his childhood confined to a room, watching the world from a distance. But his disability could not limit his curiosity or his determination to learn. With his parents’ love and his teachers’ support, Komal excelled in academics, topped his school examinations and went on to study mathematics at St. Stephen’s College, Delhi. His journey reminds us that life goes on, even when the path looks different.
